# Bid the drain, the slope, and the glass.

> Price a tiled walk-in shower from tile, waterproofing, linear drain, curbless slope, glass — and whether Saturday still pays after overtime. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper tile quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
